description: Build an expression tree from postfix tokens and evaluate its arithmetic operators. Example 1: postfix [3, 4, +, 2, *] builds a tree evaluating to 14. Example 2: [5, 2, -] evaluates to 3. Constraints: tokens form a valid expression, operators are +, -, *, or /, and division truncates toward zero.
intuition: Postfix operands are ready before their operator, so a stack can assemble each operator node.

brute_force.approach: Parse and evaluate postfix tokens directly whenever the expression is requested.

optimal.approach: Build the tree in one stack pass and evaluate recursively from its root.
optimal.space: O(n) tree plus O(h) evaluation stack

edge_cases: A one-token expression is a leaf node.
Subtraction and division preserve left/right operand order.
